lock.scope: Production, scorer, UI, source protocol, fixed generator and actual-app harness frozen before fresh generated pixels/labels. Reused camera explicitly exposed. No new default, admission or authority.

sources.sourceReview: FaceOcc1 exact edition143 source images and labels reused as exposed real-camera regression. Fresh generated renderer labels precede predictions. clean-full and unseen-copy deliberately share exact pixels; their different identities expose a limit of observation, not independent statistical trials.
limitations: Generated cases do not establish physical accuracy.
Paired identical pixels cannot determine hidden identity.
No outcome-driven method changes or source replacement.

comparison.finding:
Known-copy control: previous143 accepted 1 measurements while the target was hidden; guard144 accepted 0. The guard blocked 1 independently contradicted parent proposals and 0 correct proposals on that case.

Clean partial/full returns: guard144 24 correct versus143 24. Legitimate return after earlier competition: 6 correct parent proposals withheld, 0 incorrect proposals withheld. This conservative cost is part of the result.

Established baseline return cleared ambiguity at samples [14]; later accepted supplemental returns at [21, 22, 23]. This sequence retained 5/19 correct observations, with 0 wrong overlaps and 0 hidden outputs.

Identical-pixel limit: 12 measurements while the target was hidden in unseen-copy, with 12 labelled-copy matches. These frames are exactly the clean-full pixels with a different declared identity; this is an observability limit, not an independent statistical trial. No claim of universal copy rejection.

Reused FaceOcc1 regression: 77/92 correct, 15 missing, 0 wrong overlaps, 0 hidden outputs. This source was exposed in143; it is not fresh camera qualification. Defaults remain unchanged and no method is promoted.

diagnostics.scope: Post-run descriptive diagnostics; no method or qualification changes. Compare identity-pair traces after excluding only the memory digest, which binds different target manifests. Reference memories must otherwise match after excluding target IDs/hashes. Every original digest is independently reverified by the unchanged audit.

validation: 350 distinct Java checks, 161 desktop checks, kernel integration, agency regression, offline preparation and package/build verification passed. Actual app: 23 comparison/donor runs plus one separately reported active-ambiguity interruption check; original source/outcome verification, replay, monitor equality, baseline preservation, stopped-prefix resume, abrupt restart, complete export and tamper refusal.
